plugins.name: basivo-qa
plugins.description: Test your web app in a real browser and hand Claude a verdict it can fix from, in the same session.

plugins.name: basivo-operator
plugins.description: Do plain-language tasks on any website inside your own logged-in browser. Draft-first, human-in-the-loop before anything irreversible.

plugins.name: basivo-journal
plugins.description: Your Claude Code memory and activity journal: every session saved live to your private GitHub repo (stats + chat history, secrets masked), memory search tools, an offline report and a Vercel dashboard. Works on any OS.

plugins.name: basivo-memory
plugins.description: Shared memory across related repos: put a spec/rules repo and a code repo in one space, and Claude in either sees the pinned rules, decisions, docs and past chats of both.

plugins.name: basivo-studio
plugins.description: Logos, icons, favicons, covers and social images designed in SVG/HTML and rendered to exact-size PNGs on your machine. Text always spelled right, nothing AI-looking.

plugins.name: basivo-crew
plugins.description: Turn issues into reviewed pull requests. A crew of agents — triage, architect, developer, tester, reviewer, security — that runs in your CI on every trigger, in two tiers.

plugins.name: basivo-world
plugins.description: See your Claude Code agents live: who spawned whom, at any depth, what each is doing and what it costs — in a pane, and as a pixel-art world in your browser.
